What we do

Roofing services

From one slipped tile to a full re-roof, plus the flat roofs, roofline and chimneys that go with them.

01

New Roofs and Re-roofs

The old covering stripped back, new membrane and battens fitted, and the roof retiled from eaves to ridge.

Get a quote
02

Roof Repairs

Slipped and broken tiles, leaks, ridges and storm damage found and put right, not just patched over.

Get a quote
03

Flat Roofs

Rubber and fibreglass flat roofs for extensions, garages and dormers, with roof lanterns fitted as part of the job.

Get a quote
04

Fascias, Soffits and Guttering

Rotten boards replaced with UPVC fascias and soffits, and new gutters and downpipes that carry the water away.

Get a quote
05

Chimneys

Chimney stacks repointed and capped, pots and cowls fitted, and the flashing round the base sealed.

Get a quote
06

Roof Windows

Velux style roof windows fitted into new and existing roofs, flashed in so they stay dry.

Get a quote

Project 01

Rotten fascia replaced at the gable

The old timber fascia had split and rotted through at the corner. It was stripped out and replaced with white UPVC fascia and soffit, with a dry verge along the gable so the edge stays sealed.

Rotten boards removedUPVC fascia and soffitDry verge fittedNo more painting
Before
After
Project 02

Bungalow re-roofed in red tiles

A full re-roof on a bungalow. The old covering came off, new breathable membrane and battens went down across the whole roof, and it was retiled in red interlocking tiles with the scaffold up all round.

Why choose us

Done properly, and you can see it

Most of a roof is out of sight. These are the things that make the difference a few winters on.

Free, no obligation quotes

We look at the actual roof, tell you what it needs and what can wait, and give you a clear price. No pressure.

No callout charge

Coming out to look at a leak or a slipped tile costs you nothing. If it needs work, you get the price before anything starts.

Homes and businesses

Residential and commercial roofing, pitched or flat, from a single repair to a complete new roof.

Straight advice

Roofers who know the trade and will tell you honestly what your roof needs, so you only pay for work that is worth doing.

Clean and tidy

We bring the materials, keep the disruption to a minimum and take every bit of waste away when the job is finished.

Genuinely local

Based in Ellesmere Port and working across Chester, Birkenhead, Warrington and the areas around them.

About us

Watertight Building & Roofing Ltd

A roofing company based on the Rossmore Industrial Estate in Ellesmere Port, working across Chester, Birkenhead, Warrington and the surrounding areas. Homes and businesses, pitched roofs and flat: new roofs, roof repairs, flat roofs, guttering, fascias and soffits, and chimney repairs.

Whether it is one slipped tile or a whole new roof, the approach is the same. Honest advice on what the roof actually needs, a fair price for doing it properly, and the property left clean and tidy, with every bit of waste taken away.
